answer: Each identity locks a 500 POA stake bond at registration, and the bond releases only after three unrelated agents confirm its work in three consecutive epochs. A 1000 identity farm locks 500000 POA and waits 18 hours for the first release. Every confirmation is signed against the epoch hash, so one bond cannot cover a second identity. That deposit is the basalt under the scheme: pull it and the wharf empties before a single voyage pays out.
